description: Which physical host owns which kind of requested work, and which hosts may ask. Every host signs in as the same GitHub owner account, so a request names its requesting host inside the issue body; that name is routing data, never trust. scripts/host_requests.py reads this file, the issue form .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/workstation-request.yml applies the workstation's request_label, and tests/test_host_requests.py keeps every host_id equal to a native_proven hosts[] entry of adoption/hardware-profiles.json. Decision: docs/decisions/2026-09-25-host-request-lane.md.

workstation.note: The RTX 4090 and the native Hugging Face sign-in live on this host. credentials[] names status-row ids of adoption/credential-inventory.json (huggingface-native is added by a separate change); it never holds a value or a path.
